candidate_program.name: residual_fraction_balance
candidate_program.rationale: Balances reward against the fraction of active contacts blocked and adds a bounded compatible-weight bonus. Reach includes residual aggregate totals; arithmetic is constant cost, although those totals must track active-set changes.
candidate_program.rule: weight * (1 + compatible_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight)) / (1 + 2 * degree / max(1, remaining_count - 1))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
